scenes.title: Your first study session
scenes.summary: A quick tour of the tabs and your first study loop.
points: No API key is needed for the demo
scenes.voiceover: Welcome to StudyVerse AI. This tour shows what each tab does and how the tools fit into one study session. Sample course data is ready, so you can follow along.

scenes.title: Your home base
scenes.summary: See today's mission and learning progress at a glance.
points: Streak, mastery, XP and focus time
Scroll for topics, packs and quests
scenes.voiceover: Overview is your home base. Today's mission, exam countdown, streak, mastery, XP and focus time are here. Start Mission opens the next recommended task. Scroll down for weak topics, packs and quests.

scenes.title: Organize course material
scenes.summary: Turn your notes into packs that are ready to study.
points: Choose Add material or Choose a file
Import PDF, slides, Word docs or images
scenes.next: Nova Tutor - learn from a pack
scenes.voiceover: StudyPacks is your course shelf. Choose Add material or Choose a file to import a PDF, presentation, Word document or image. Open a pack to study from it. In demo mode, uploads stay in the browser; sample packs are ready now.

scenes.title: Learn with Nova
scenes.summary: Ask questions grounded in your selected StudyPack.
points: Socratic or Exam - change the teaching style
scenes.voiceover: Nova Tutor helps you learn from a selected StudyPack. Ask a question, then choose Learn for an explanation, Hint for a nudge, Socratic for guiding questions, or Exam for concise test-style help. Citations point back to your notes.

scenes.title: Practice with confidence
scenes.summary: Check your answer and tell Nova how sure you felt.
points: Check to update mastery and spot gaps
scenes.next: Boss Battle - take a timed challenge
scenes.voiceover: Practice asks one question at a time. Choose an answer, rate confidence from one to five, then check it. Nova uses confidence as well as correctness to update your mastery and spot possible misconceptions.

scenes.title: Take a full challenge
scenes.summary: Use Graph Guardian after reviewing a topic.
scenes.voiceover: For a timed challenge, select Boss battle at the top of Practice. It starts the Graph Guardian assessment with ten questions and no hints. Use it after reviewing a topic.

scenes.title: Recall, reveal, repeat
scenes.summary: Use spaced repetition to revisit each concept at the right time.
points: Rate it Again, Hard, Good or Easy
scenes.voiceover: Flashcards use active recall. Try to answer before you reveal the back, then rate it Again, Hard, Good or Easy. Hard cards return sooner; easy cards wait longer.

scenes.title: Fix the idea behind a miss
scenes.summary: Turn a likely misconception into a clear next step.
points: Mark fixed when you can explain it
scenes.voiceover: Mistake Lab gathers your missed concepts, including answers marked with high confidence. Review the explanation, then mark an item fixed when you can explain the correction.

scenes.title: See how topics connect
scenes.summary: Follow prerequisite links to decide what to study first.
scenes.voiceover: Skill tree maps topics and prerequisites. Find a lower mastery node, then follow its connections to see what to study first.

scenes.title: Choose your next block
scenes.summary: Use a short, adaptive plan to keep the day moving.
points: Use the remaining list for your next step
scenes.next: Focus room - make time for the work
scenes.voiceover: Study planner turns your priorities into today's blocks. Complete a block when it's done, and use the remaining list to pick a next step.

scenes.title: Start a Pomodoro
scenes.summary: Work on one topic with a timer and fewer distractions.
points: Finish to record focus time and XP
scenes.voiceover: Focus room is your Pomodoro timer. Choose a duration, start the timer, and work on one topic. Completing a session records focus time and earns XP.

scenes.title: Look back, then level up
scenes.summary: See the habits and topics that shaped your week.
points: Review active days and focus time
Pick one area for next week
scenes.voiceover: Study Wrapped is your weekly recap. Review active days, focus time, XP and top concepts, then choose one area to keep building next week.

scenes.title: Browse shared study rooms
scenes.summary: Find a room by subject and focus style.
points: Join a demo room to see the flow
Live chat and presence are not included yet
scenes.voiceover: Study rooms is the demo directory for shared study. Browse a room and join to see the flow. This demo shows room listings; live chat and presence are not part of it yet.

scenes.title: Personalize your space
scenes.summary: Check your progress and adjust the look of StudyVerse.
scenes.next: Demo progress stays in this browser session
scenes.voiceover: Your profile shows your level, XP, badges and learning preferences. Change the accent theme here. In demo mode, progress stays in this browser session.

scenes.title: One small step at a time
scenes.summary: StudyVerse connects learning, practice and review.
points: Return to Overview for the next mission
scenes.voiceover: A simple first session is: open a StudyPack, learn with Nova, practice, fix a mistake, then focus and review flashcards. Return to Overview for your next mission. Let's get started.
